title: Chatbots Allegedly Used in Romance Scams Targeting Nearly One-Third of New Zealand's Dating App Users

behaviors.text: A Norton Cyber Safety Insights Report found that nearly one-third of New Zealand dating app users have been targeted by romance scams, with AI chatbots allegedly playing a growing role.
The report, based on a January 2025 survey, indicates that 50% of dating app users believed they had interacted with AI-generated messages.
